title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩原始图并利用图自编码器与循环神经网络学习时序图的高质量表征，在保持性能的同时显著降低内存消耗和训练时间。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses the original graph via graph summarization and learns high-quality representations of sequential graphs using a graph autoencoder and a recurrent neural network, significantly reducing memory consumption and training time while maintaining performance.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩并输入图自编码器
利用与原始图的重构误差训练原图节点表征
使用循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots at each time step
Compress original graph via graph summarization and input into a graph autoencoder
Train node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Learn temporal features and dependencies via a recurrent neural network
source_locations: 正文：GSAERU 模型的构成与训练方法

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，结合基于边分割的图流划分与图摘要小批量训练，并通过注意力层汇总梯度，加速大规模图流数据的GNN训练并提升链路预测性能。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed DSGNN, a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode, combines edge-partition-based graph streaming partitioning with graph summarization based mini-batch training, and aggregates gradients through an attention layer, accelerating GNN training on large-scale graph streaming data and improving link prediction performance.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式进行分布式训练
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点并计算梯度
根据梯度同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Adopt a leader-worker mode for distributed training
Leader partitions the original graph using an edge-segmentation-based graph streaming partitioning algorithm
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer for gradient computation
Synchronously update models on all computing nodes according to the gradient
source_locations: 正文：DSGNN 模型的分布式训练流程

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于在大规模图数据中高效划分子图并分配给分布式计算节点，支持后续图神经网络训练。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed an edge-segmentation-based graph streaming partitioning algorithm for efficiently partitioning large-scale graphs into subgraphs and assigning them to distributed computing nodes, supporting subsequent graph neural network training.
technical_features: 以边分割为基础进行图流划分
从流式数据中动态划分原图
将划分后的子图分配给各工作节点
适用于大规模图数据的分布式处理
technical_features_en: Partition graph stream based on edge segmentation
Dynamically partition the original graph from streaming data
Assign partitioned subgraphs to worker nodes
Suitable for distributed processing of large-scale graph data
source_locations: 论文摘要：DSGNN 模型中提到的图流划分算法
正文：领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法进行划分
